scenes.text: Your Halloween pumpkin is actually a giant berry, at least to a botanist.
In botany, a berry is a simple fleshy fruit that usually has many seeds.
Pumpkins are a special kind of berry called a pepo, with a hard rind and lots of seeds.
Watermelons and cucumbers are pepos too, and bananas and tomatoes also count as berries.
But strawberries and raspberries are not true berries at all.
They grow from flowers with many tiny ovaries, which makes them aggregate fruits instead.
Which fruit fact surprised you the most?

title: Your pumpkin is technically a giant berry 🎃
caption: Botanically, a pumpkin is a berry called a pepo, just like watermelons and cucumbers. Bananas and tomatoes are berries too, but strawberries are not! 🎃
